product_family: Originally a no-code predictive analytics / AutoML tool ("Obviously AI"). In February 2025 the company rebranded to Zams and pivoted the product entirely: it is now an agentic "AI workers" platform for sales/GTM teams (AI workers named Evan, Iris, Nico, Nova, Atlas) that automates CRM hygiene, meeting prep, account monitoring, forecasting, and reporting across connected business tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, email, calendar, etc.). The legacy no-code AutoML product is discontinued; obviously.ai now redirects to zams.com and is kept only as an archive notice.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Zams' SOC 2 Type II report covers the trust services categories of Security, Confidentiality, and Availability, and is audited annually.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: The vendor's security page states only that 'All customer data is hosted in data centers that are SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HITRUST compliant.' This describes Zams' cloud host (Google Cloud) infrastructure certification, not a certification held by Zams/Obviously AI, Inc. itself. No independent ISO 27001 certificate for the vendor entity was found on the trust center.

certifications.name: HITRUST
certifications.proof_quote: Same host-infrastructure statement as ISO 27001 above ('data centers that are ... HITRUST compliant'); this is the cloud host's certification, not the vendor's own.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Zams is HIPAA compliant, and is prepared and able to execute a standard Business Associate Agreement.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: We comply with GDPR data retention requirements, and offer a data processing agreement (DPA) for customers in the EU.

certifications.name: CCPA/CPRA
certifications.proof_quote: We ensure policies, processes, and controls comply with CCPA requirements.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: Trust center lists CSA STAR as a compliant framework alongside SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, and CPRA badges.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; not listed on the security page or trust center, and no independent source confirms ISO 42001 certification.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification; not listed on security page or trust center. Payment processing is presumably handled by a third-party billing provider, not disclosed.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization on vendor site.

privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy states plainly: 'Zams does not use Customer Data to train any proprietary or third-party AI models, including foundation models, unless explicitly authorized in writing.' No tiered exceptions or opt-in/opt-out toggle were found in public docs; the policy frames it as opt-in-only (written authorization required), not an opt-out you must remember to set.
privacy.data_region: Primary hosting/processing in the United States (Google Cloud); privacy policy states 'The Services are operated in the United States' with international transfers consented to on use. Security page separately notes EU traffic is kept in-region via Cloudflare load balancing with servers in the Netherlands and UK.

security.name: Encryption in transit and at rest
security.value: TLS and AES-256 encryption used for data protection.

security.name: Cloud infrastructure
security.value: Hosted in Google Cloud data centers (physically secure, 24/7 on-site security, camera surveillance per vendor).

security.name: EU data residency
security.value: Intra-European traffic stays within Europe via Cloudflare load balancing with servers in the Netherlands and UK.

security.name: Session/recording data handling
security.value: Data is sent only during active sessions and deleted afterward unless recordings are enabled.

security.name: Trust center platform
security.value: Public trust center is powered by Sprinto and gates full audit reports/documents behind a 'Request access' form; only summary compliance badges are publicly visible.

products.name: Zams AI Workers (current product, formerly "Obviously AI")
products.data_scope: Connects to and acts across CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot), email, calendar, Slack, and 40+ other integrations to read/write live business data on the customer's behalf.
products.notes: Named AI workers. This is the live, actively sold product.

products.name: Obviously AI (legacy, discontinued)
products.data_scope: Customer-uploaded datasets (CSV/Excel) used to build predictive models via natural-language prompts.
products.notes: This is the discontinued product this listing was originally built around. obviously.ai now redirects and archives to zams.com with a banner stating 'Obviously AI is now Zams. This site is an archive of how it operated through 2025.' Not available for new signups under the old branding.

compare.pricing_model: SaaS subscription, demo/sales-assisted onboarding ('Book a demo'); public self-serve pricing not fully disclosed on marketing site.
compare.data_residency: US-primary (Google Cloud), with EU traffic kept in-region (Netherlands/UK) per Cloudflare routing.

flags: This listing's original name, "Obviously AI," refers to a product that no longer exists under that name. Obviously AI, Inc. rebranded to Zams in February 2025 and pivoted from a no-code predictive-analytics/AutoML tool to an agentic sales-automation platform ('AI workers'). This is the same legal entity, not a different company with a similar name; the vendor's terms of use and privacy policy both open with 'Obviously AI, Inc. (dba. Zams),' and obviously.ai now shows an archive banner redirecting to zams.com.

The security page's ISO 27001 and HITRUST claims are phrased as properties of the underlying Google Cloud data centers ('data centers that are SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HITRUST compliant'), not certifications Zams itself holds. Only SOC 2 Type II is stated in the first person as the vendor's own report.

Trust center (zams.trust.site, Sprinto-powered) only shows summary compliance badges; full audit reports, SOC 2 report scope/date, and CSA STAR assessment level (self-assessment vs. third-party certified) are gated behind a 'Request access' form and are not independently verified.

AI-training posture is a clean, customer-favorable no-training-without-written-authorization statement in the current privacy policy; no legacy Obviously AI ToS language was found that contradicts this.
